{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module TemplateEngine where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- Role-based access control
data Role = Guest | User | Admin deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Read)

data Session = Session
  { sessionUser :: Text
  , sessionRole :: Role
  , sessionData :: Map Text Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- Template AST
data TemplateExpr
  = TLiteral Text
  | TVariable Text
  | TConditional Text TemplateExpr TemplateExpr
  | TLoop Text Text TemplateExpr
  | TInclude Text
  | TRaw Text
  deriving (Show)

-- Serialization format for template cache
data SerializedTemplate = SerializedTemplate
  { stName :: Text
  , stBody :: Text
  , stCachedRole :: Role
  , stInterpolated :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

-- Global template registry
{-# NOINLINE templateRegistry #-}
templateRegistry :: IORef (Map Text SerializedTemplate)
templateRegistry = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

-- Register a template with role requirement
registerTemplate :: Text -> Text -> Role -> IO ()
registerTemplate name body minRole = do
  let st = SerializedTemplate name body minRole False
  modifyIORef' templateRegistry (Map.insert name st)

-- Deserialize and reconstruct template from cache
deserializeTemplate :: SerializedTemplate -> Session -> Either Text Text
deserializeTemplate st session =
  if sessionRole session >= stCachedRole st
    then Right $ interpolateBody (stBody st) session
    else Left "Access denied: insufficient role"

-- The core interpolation engine
interpolateBody :: Text -> Session -> Text
interpolateBody body session = processSegments (T.splitOn "{{" body) session

processSegments :: [Text] -> Session -> Text
processSegments [] _ = ""
processSegments [x] _ = x
processSegments (before:rest) session =
  before <> processExpression rest session

processExpression :: [Text] -> Session -> Text
processExpression [] _ = ""
processExpression (segment:rest) session =
  case T.splitOn "}}" segment of
    [expr, after] ->
      let resolved = resolveExpression (T.strip expr) session
      in resolved <> after <> processSegments rest session
    _ -> segment <> processSegments rest session

-- Expression resolver with role-gated features
resolveExpression :: Text -> Session -> Text
resolveExpression expr session
  | T.isPrefixOf "eval:" expr = handleEval (T.drop 5 expr) session
  | T.isPrefixOf "lookup:" expr = handleLookup (T.drop 7 expr) session
  | T.isPrefixOf "role:" expr = handleRoleCheck (T.drop 5 expr) session
  | otherwise = lookupVariable expr session

-- Variable lookup from session data
lookupVariable :: Text -> Session -> Text
lookupVariable key session =
  fromMaybe ("[undefined:" <> key <> "]") (Map.lookup key (sessionData session))

-- Role check expression
handleRoleCheck :: Text -> Session -> Text
handleRoleCheck roleExpr session =
  let requiredRole = read (T.unpack roleExpr) :: Role
  in if sessionRole session >= requiredRole
     then "true"
     else "false"

-- Lookup with nested interpolation
handleLookup :: Text -> Session -> Text
handleLookup key session =
  let resolvedKey = interpolateBody key session
  in lookupVariable resolvedKey session

-- Eval handler - supposedly admin-only but check is flawed
handleEval :: Text -> Session -> Text
handleEval code session =
  let roleCheck = checkEvalPermission session
  in if roleCheck
     then unsafeEval code
     else "[eval:denied]"

-- Permission check for eval - uses serialized role from template cache
checkEvalPermission :: Session -> Bool
checkEvalPermission session = sessionRole session >= Admin

-- Dangerous eval function
unsafeEval :: Text -> Text
unsafeEval code = T.pack $ unsafePerformIO $ do
  let cmd = T.unpack code
  -- In real code this would execute arbitrary commands
  return $ "[executed:" ++ cmd ++ "]"

-- Template composition - merges templates with role elevation
composeTemplates :: Text -> Text -> Session -> IO (Either Text Text)
composeTemplates baseName overlayName session = do
  registry <- readIORef templateRegistry
  case (Map.lookup baseName registry, Map.lookup overlayName registry) of
    (Just base, Just overlay) -> do
      let mergedBody = stBody base <> stBody overlay
      -- BUG: merged template inherits the LOWER role requirement
      -- allowing overlay content to bypass its own role check
      let mergedRole = min (stCachedRole base) (stCachedRole overlay)
      let merged = SerializedTemplate
            { stName = baseName <> "+" <> overlayName
            , stBody = mergedBody
            , stCachedRole = mergedRole
            , stInterpolated = False
            }
      return $ deserializeTemplate merged session
    _ -> return $ Left "Template not found"

-- Public API: render a template for a session
renderTemplate :: Text -> Session -> IO (Either Text Text)
renderTemplate name session = do
  registry <- readIORef templateRegistry
  case Map.lookup name registry of
    Just st -> return $ deserializeTemplate st session
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Template not found"

-- Render with user-supplied overlay (the actual attack vector)
renderWithOverlay :: Text -> Text -> Session -> IO (Either Text Text)
renderWithOverlay baseName userTemplate session = do
  -- Register user template with Guest role (user-supplied content)
  registerTemplate "__user_overlay" userTemplate Guest
  -- Compose with base template
  composeTemplates baseName "__user_overlay" session

-- Example setup
initializeTemplates :: IO ()
initializeTemplates = do
  registerTemplate "welcome" "Hello, {{username}}!" Guest
  registerTemplate "admin_panel" "{{eval:cat /etc/passwd}}" Admin
  registerTemplate "dashboard" "Welcome {{username}}. Status: {{status}}" User
